_scope: startup ONLY. ivc and pfc are not touched by this pass.
_naming_law: <Type display name> — <qualifier>. Display name from the REGISTER, not the source document. Qualifier only to distinguish siblings, and it states the distinction (service, medium, fuel, configuration). Never a system context; never a number. A qualifier that does not change the checklist does not belong in the checklist's name.
_correction_to_the_proposal: The proposal reported startup/pump sets 1-3 as differing by 'six rows out of forty'. The raw label diff is 19/13, but the surplus is WORDING, not checks: '&' vs 'and', a trailing period, and the boilerplate tail 'as per Drawings and Specifications'. After reconciling those, exactly six genuinely distinct checks remain in the 34-row set. The figure was right; the method that produced it was luckier than it looked, so the harness now reconciles explicitly and REFUSES on any row it cannot account for.
